title: Deploy StartSimpli API to ECS via rc CLI
close_reason: StartSimpli API fully deployed to ECS. 7 services running in ss-debuggai-prod cluster (us-west-2). Service Connect enabled. All health checks passing.

title: ALB name truncation causes collisions; ECSDeploymentService._log_step uses print()
description:
alb_service.py:69-70, 112-113, 259-260 - Blind truncation to 32 chars means 'my-very-long-cluster-name-production' and 'my-very-long-cluster-name-staging' collide. Use hash suffix for uniqueness.

ecs_deployment_service.py:916-921 - _log_step calls print() unconditionally. Library should never print() directly — use self.log_info()/log_warning() instead.

ecs_deployment_service.py:242,270 - deployment._duration monkey-patches a non-model attribute onto a Django model instance. Won't survive serialization. Use model field or return as separate value.
close_reason: ALB + logging fixes complete

title: S1: Persist auto-generated encryption key to disk
description: cli.py:108-111 — When no REMOTE_COMPOSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY env var is set, generate a key AND persist it to ~/.remote-compose/<project>/encryption.key. On subsequent runs, load from disk before generating new. Must create directory if it doesn't exist, set 0600 permissions on key file.
close_reason: Encryption key now persisted to ~/.remote-compose/{project}/encryption.key with 0600 perms

title: Dead code: getattr/try-except, _convert_efs_volumes param, _serialize_rule
description: 1) cli.py:639 getattr overwritten by try/except on line 640-643. 2) compose_converter.py:1039 _convert_efs_volumes accepts named_volumes param but never uses it. 3) security_group_service.py:365-368 _serialize_rule just returns dict(rule) — no-op. 4) mark_healthy/mark_unhealthy in targets.py are near-identical. Fix: remove dead code, extract _update_health_status.

title: S1: Add default IsAuthenticated permission and SessionAuthentication to all viewsets
description:
api/viewsets.py — Add to every viewset (or a base mixin class):
  permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
  authentication_classes = [SessionAuthentication, BasicAuthentication]
Import from rest_framework. This is a sensible default that consuming projects can override via DRF settings.
close_reason: Added SecuredViewSetMixin (auth+perms), pagination, removed log nesting, fixed error codes

title: No vpc_cidr format validation before AWS API call
description: DeploymentConfig.vpc_cidr accepted as raw string, passed directly to AWS. Invalid CIDR only caught by AWS API with unhelpful error. Fix: validate with ipaddress.ip_network() in DeploymentConfig.__post_init__ or in VPC step.

title: S2: Refactor EFSService to use AWSClientFactory via constructor injection
description: efs_service.py:58-106 — Remove _get_efs_client() and _get_ec2_client() methods (the ec2 one is a verbatim copy from ecs_service.py). Accept AWSClientFactory in __init__. Remove redundant CredentialService instantiation (line 51). Update callers/tests.
close_reason: EFSService now uses AWSClientFactory, ~48 lines removed

title: Converter creates new instance per step, not in ServiceRegistry
description: Each step creates fresh ComposeToECSConverter(), warnings collected per-instance. Not registered in ServiceRegistry so can't be shared/mocked consistently. Steps collect warnings via converter.warnings but only from that particular call. Fix: register in ServiceRegistry or pass warnings through context more explicitly.

title: AWSClientFactory singleton not safe for multi-tenant Django; 12 convenience methods add no value
description:
aws_client_factory.py:377-401 - Global singleton with double-checked locking. In multi-tenant Django where different requests use different AWS credentials, all tenants share the same factory instance and its default_region.

aws_client_factory.py:188-274 - 12 convenience methods (get_ecs_client, get_ecr_client, etc.) are all single-line wrappers around get_client(). 90 lines of code with zero additional logic. Callers can just use factory.get_client('ecs', ...).

ecr_service.py:590-615 - get_account_id() duplicates STS call already in factory's validate_credentials().
close_reason: Factory cleanup complete

title: Duplicated polling/wait loops across 8+ services — need shared poll_until()
description:
Identical timeout-polling pattern (start_time, while loop, try/except, time.sleep, raise on timeout) appears in:
- ecs_service.py:679-732 (wait_for_service_stable)
- efs_service.py:405-441, 868-931, 933-970 (three different wait methods)
- vpc_service.py:333-367, 482-505 (NAT gateway create/delete)
- alb_service.py:724-755 (wait_for_alb_active)
- service_connect_service.py:230-286 (wait_for_operation)
Extract shared utility: poll_until(check_fn, timeout, interval, timeout_error). Cuts ~200 lines.
close_reason: Polling dedup complete

title: Delete nginx ECS service (LB can't be added to existing service)
description: AWS ECS doesn't allow updating loadBalancers on an existing service via our update_service code path. Must delete the ss-debuggai-nginx ECS service so it gets recreated with the target group attached on next deploy. Steps: scale to 0, delete service, delete ECSServiceModel from DB. Other 6 services stay untouched.
close_reason: Deleted ss-debuggai-nginx ECS service and DB record

title: EFS defaults to root UID/GID 0 with 0777 permissions
description: efs_service.py:40-43 sets DEFAULT_UID=0, DEFAULT_GID=0, DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS='0777'. All access points get root+world-writable by default. Docstring at line 498-499 LIES claiming defaults are 1000/1000/0755. Fix: default to 1000/1000/0755, fix docstring, offer permissive settings only as named constants for specific use cases.

title: CLI resource leaks: backup_file no-op, temp file leak, fd leak
description: 1) cli.py:1202-1203 has no-op ternary: both branches identical (backup_file if '/' in backup_file else backup_file). 2) _write_service_config temp file leaked on exception, not cleaned up in finally. 3) _exec_interactive leaks /dev/tty fd if subprocess.run raises (cli.py:353-358). Fix: fix ternary, use context manager for temp file and tty.

title: Tracking models: ResourceMetric has 3 copy-pasted factory methods; BuildRecord.mark_skipped abuses error_message field; no data retention
description:
tracking.py:572-653 - record_ecs_metric, record_efs_metric, record_cluster_metric are copy-pasted with only FK difference. Consolidate into _record_metric(target_type, target, ...).

tracking.py:244 - mark_skipped re-purposes error_message for skip reason (comment says 'Re-use field for skip reason'). Use metadata JSONField or add skip_reason field.

tracking.py - ResourceMetric has no data retention strategy. Time-series table grows unboundedly. Need cleanup job or documented retention policy.

tracking.py:112-115 - BuildRecord.build_log is unbounded TextField. Docker build logs can be megabytes. Consider truncation on save or offload to object storage.
close_reason: Tracking model cleanup complete

title: S3: Extract _get_cluster() and _resolve_service() CLI helpers
description:
cli.py — Extract two helpers:
1. _get_cluster(config) → ECSCluster: replaces the 8 identical try/except blocks (lines 264,504,617,683,773,857,916,1329)
2. _resolve_service(cluster, project_name, service_name) → ECSService: replaces 5 identical resolution+error patterns (lines 271-279, 691-697, 782-789, etc.)
Update all commands to use the helpers.
close_reason: Extracted _get_cluster() (6 callsites) and _resolve_service() (3 callsites)

title: ECS/ECR/EFS services bypass AWSClientFactory
description: ECSService, ECRService, EFSService each have own _get_*_client methods calling boto3.client() directly, bypassing AWSClientFactory's caching, credential validation, and SUPPORTED_SERVICES whitelist. 7 identical credential-handling boilerplate copies. Fix: migrate all three to use factory.get_client(), remove _get_ecs_client/_get_ecr_client/_get_efs_client/_get_ec2_client/_get_sts_client methods.

title: S1: Fix Deployment.DeploymentStatus → Deployment.Status in finalization.py
description: finalization.py:36,127 use Deployment.DeploymentStatus.COMPLETED but the model defines Deployment.Status (TextChoices). Also multi_service.py:711 uses raw string 'completed'. Standardize on Deployment.Status.COMPLETED everywhere.
close_reason: Fixed in pipeline steps: context.errors→warnings, DeploymentStatus→Status, repository_uri→aws_repository_uri

title: describe_tasks does not batch — will fail for >100 task ARNs
description: ecs_service.py:829-849 passes all task ARNs to describe_tasks. AWS API accepts max 100 per call. >100 ARNs will cause rejection. Fix: chunk task_arns into batches of 100.

title: S3: Fix ALB name truncation to use hash suffix; replace print() with logging in ECSDeploymentService
description: alb_service.py:69-70, 112-113, 259-260 — When name exceeds 32 chars, use name[:24]-{hash[:7]} pattern instead of blind truncation. ecs_deployment_service.py:916-921 — Replace print() calls in _log_step with self.log_info()/log_warning(). Also fix monkey-patched deployment._duration (lines 242,270) — return duration as separate value or store in deployment.metadata.
close_reason: ALB uses hash suffix truncation; print() removed from _log_step; deployment._duration→metadata

title: S2: Make security group ports configurable (not just 5432/6379)
description: security_group_service.py:276-300 — Database hardcoded to PostgreSQL port 5432, cache to Redis port 6379. Accept port as parameter in the security group rule methods. Read from compose service metadata or service config YAML. Default to current values for backwards compatibility.
close_reason: Security group ports now parameters with backwards-compatible defaults

title: S1: Fix ecs_teardown.py: consolidate duplicate imports, add exception logging
description: ecs_teardown.py imports get_aws_client_factory 4 times inside method bodies (lines 125, 153, 213, 256). Move to module level. Replace all 'except Exception: pass' blocks with logged warnings matching the cli.py fixes.
close_reason: Teardown now logs warnings and only deletes local records on AWS success

title: Duplicate _convert_service and _convert_preprocessed_service (~90% identical)
description: compose_converter.py:481-569 vs 571-650 are ~90% identical. Both build container defs, call same converters. Only differ in env var sourcing. Every bug fix must be applied in both. Fix: merge by having _convert_service create lightweight PreprocessedService and delegate, or extract shared _build_container_definition.

title: S4: Fix minor code quality issues across codebase
description:
Batch of small fixes:
- Move inline imports (json, time, ClientError) to module top in ecs_service.py, ecs_deployment_service.py, alb_service.py, service_connect_service.py
- Add warnings to _parse_memory and _parse_duration when falling back to defaults (compose_converter.py:731-738, 884)
- Add model clean() validation: min_count <= desired_count <= max_count (ecs.py:374-385)
- Fix ECSTaskDefinition.to_aws_format empty-list fallback (ecs.py:299) — use 'is not None' check
- Rename services/ECSService class to ECSServiceManager to avoid collision with models/ECSService
- Add defensive type guard to VPCInfrastructure.all_subnet_ids (infrastructure.py:64-66)
- Replace MD5 with SHA256 in EFSService.create_access_point (efs_service.py:522)
- Fix _exec_interactive file descriptor leak (cli.py:327-329) — use 'with' statement
- Fix pipeline step mutable instance state (_created_access_points, _created_services) — reset in execute()
close_reason: Inline imports moved, parse warnings added, model validation, empty-list fix, type guard, MD5→SHA256, step state reset

title: EFS _find_file_system_by_name has N+1 API calls and uses deprecated API
description: efs_service.py:241-251 iterates every EFS file system in account, making separate describe_tags call for each. describe_tags is deprecated (replaced by list_tags_for_resource). Tags already included in describe_file_systems response. Fix: read tags from fs.get('Tags', []) directly, remove describe_tags call.

title: Update rc.yml with unique cluster name for debuggai
close_reason: Closed

title: Run rc provision to create ALB
description: Run 'rc provision' in the start-simpli-api directory. The infrastructure_provisioning pipeline has ProvisionALBStep which creates an internet-facing ALB when public_services exist. nginx is already marked public:true in rc.yml. The step will: create ALB in public subnets, create HTTP listener on port 80 forwarding to a default target group, save LoadBalancerConfig to DB. VPC/SGs/IAM/SC already exist so those steps will be no-ops (get-or-create). Must also create an ALB security group that allows inbound HTTP (port 80) from 0.0.0.0/0.
close_reason: ALB provisioned: ss-debuggai-prod-alb-378155331.us-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com

title: Credential create serializer accepts garbage credential_value
description: SecureCredentialCreateSerializer.create() uses .get() on credential_value dict without validating required keys. access_key_id/secret_access_key can be None for AWS creds, private_key can be None for SSH. Fix: add validate() method checking credential_type-specific required keys. File: api/serializers.py:129-150

title: Encryption key silently auto-generated every CLI session
description: cli.py:120-123 generates a new Fernet key in-memory if REMOTE_COMPOSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set. Credentials encrypted in previous sessions are permanently unrecoverable. No warning shown. Fix: persist the key to disk like secret_key, or refuse to start without explicit key. File: cli.py:120-123

title: Exception chains missing 'from e' throughout codebase
description: ecs_deployment_service.py:292 and many other locations raise new exceptions without 'from e', destroying original tracebacks. E.g., raise ECSDeploymentError(f'Deployment failed: {e}') loses root cause. Fix: use 'raise XError(...) from e' pattern throughout.

title: logs:CreateLogGroup IAM policy grants Resource: * — overly broad
description: ecs_service.py:1006-1017 inline policy for CreateLogGroup uses Resource: '*'. Should be scoped to specific log group pattern like arn:aws:logs:*:*:log-group:/ecs/*. Unnecessary broad permissions.

title: Minor code quality: inline imports, silent parse defaults, model validation gaps, ECSService name collision
description:
Scattered minor issues:
- ecs_service.py, ecs_deployment_service.py, alb_service.py, service_connect_service.py: 'import json', 'import time', 'from botocore...' inside method bodies instead of module top
- compose_converter.py:731-738, 884: _parse_memory and _parse_duration silently return defaults (512, 30) on unrecognized formats with no warning
- ecs.py:374-385: No model validation ensuring min_count <= desired_count <= max_count
- ecs.py:299: to_aws_format silently falls back to ['FARGATE'] when requires_compatibilities is empty list
- models/ECSService vs services/ECSService name collision forces alias gymnastics everywhere
- infrastructure.py:64-66: VPCInfrastructure.all_subnet_ids can crash if JSON fields contain None
- efs_service.py:522: Uses MD5 for client token (not security-critical but triggers scanners, use sha256)
- exceptions.py: Error code ranges documented in comments but never enforced (code parameter always defaults to None)
- pipeline steps store mutable instance state (_created_access_points, _created_services) that accumulates across reuse
- image_build_service.py:633: ECR URI pattern uses hyphen separator while pipeline uses slash — different repos for same service
- infrastructure.py:188-218: ProvisionALBStep uses click.echo directly instead of pipeline event system
close_reason: All minor code quality fixes applied

title: context.py: 500 lines of boilerplate properties + 60-param __init__
description: 290 lines of mechanical property getter/setter pairs delegating to sub-contexts. __init__ accepts 60+ parameters for backward compat. Every new field requires property pair + __init__ param + builder block. Fix: use __getattr__/__setattr__ for dynamic delegation, or drop compat layer. Provide from_flat() classmethod for old construction. File: deployment_pipeline/context.py

title: TOCTOU race in _get_or_create_service_model
description: ecs.py:168-216 checks DB then checks AWS then creates record. Between check and create, another process could create same record. No get_or_create or unique constraint. Fix: use ECSServiceModel.objects.get_or_create() or wrap in select_for_update() transaction.

title: Add ACM certificate provisioning to rc provision
description: When certificate_arn is set in rc.yml, rc provision should: (1) validate the cert exists and matches the region, (2) configure the ALB with an HTTPS listener on 443 with the cert, (3) add HTTP→HTTPS redirect on port 80. The ProvisionALBStep already handles this when certificate_arn is passed — just need to ensure rc.yml certificate_arn flows through correctly and the ALB gets updated if it was initially created without a cert.
close_reason: Added upgrade_alb_to_https() to ALBService, updated ProvisionALBStep to auto-upgrade HTTP ALBs when certificate_arn is provided

title: S1: Fix ecr_repo.repository_uri → aws_repository_uri in multi_service.py
description: multi_service.py:250 uses ecr_repo.repository_uri (nonexistent field). Line 249 correctly checks ecr_repo.aws_repository_uri. Fix line 250 to match.
close_reason: Fixed in pipeline steps: context.errors→warnings, DeploymentStatus→Status, repository_uri→aws_repository_uri

title: Run rc deploy to recreate nginx with ALB target group
description: Run 'rc deploy --no-build --tag v5' to redeploy. The deploy pipeline's CreateTargetGroupsStep will create a target group for nginx (since public_services is set and load_balancer exists). Then CreateOrUpdateMultiServiceStep will recreate the nginx service with loadBalancers config pointing to the target group. Other 6 services get updated normally. After deploy, the ALB DNS name is the public URL — access Django admin at http://<alb-dns>/admin/.
close_reason: ALB serving Django admin at http://ss-debuggai-prod-alb-378155331.us-west-2.elb.amazonaws.com/admin/

title: VPC _get_vpc_cidr returns fallback 10.0.0.0/8 instead of failing
description: efs_service.py:1146 returns '10.0.0.0/8' when VPC has no CidrBlock. A /8 CIDR creates overly permissive NFS security group rules. Should raise error instead of silently defaulting. Fix: raise EFSError if no CidrBlock found.

title: Fix current deployment: add cert to ALB and configure HTTPS
description: Immediate fix for ss-debuggai-prod: (1) Create or identify ACM cert for the ALB domain, (2) Add certificate_arn to rc.yml, (3) Run rc provision to update ALB with HTTPS listener, (4) Update production.py to read CSRF/cookie/SSL settings from env vars, (5) Push updated secrets with correct CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS and cookie settings, (6) Redeploy. This is the manual fix needed now, before the auto-inject feature is built.
close_reason: Fixed current deployment: production.py reads cookie/SSL settings from env vars, ConfigureInfrastructureEnv step injects correct values (HTTP mode), CSRF cookie now sets correctly.

title: Hardcoded values scattered: regions, timeouts, ports, health paths, IAM roles
description: us-west-2 in 6+ places in cli.py. us-east-1 default in converter/preprocessor/targets. Timeout 600/300 in multiple places. Health check '/health' hardcoded. IAM role 'ecsTaskExecutionRole' 6 times. DB port 5432, cache port 6379. Presigned URL ExpiresIn=7200. ALB SSL policy. Fix: define constants, pull from REMOTE_COMPOSE settings dict.

title: S2: Make assignPublicIp and enableExecuteCommand configurable
description:
Three locations to fix:
1. ecs_service.py:774 — assignPublicIp: 'ENABLED' hardcoded in run_task(). Add parameter, derive default from subnet type (private→DISABLED, public→ENABLED).
2. ecs_service.py:551 — enableExecuteCommand: True forced on every update_service(). Make configurable, default False for security.
3. ecs.py:567,575 — Same two values hardcoded in ECSService model to_aws_create_format(). Add model fields with sensible defaults.
close_reason: assignPublicIp and enableExecuteCommand now model fields with configurable defaults

title: AuditLog doesn't extend TimestampedModel + duplicate index on aws_instance_id
description: 1) audit.py:9 AuditLog extends models.Model directly, every other model uses TimestampedModel. 2) targets.py:58 has db_index=True on aws_instance_id AND line 103 includes it in Meta.indexes — duplicate index wastes storage. 3) Only ECR/EFS models have __repr__, rest rely on __str__. Fix: extend TimestampedModel, remove duplicate index, add __repr__.

title: S2: Remove hardcoded us-east-1 default; make SecurityGroupConfig.Purpose labels generic
description: ecs.py:57 — aws_region defaults to 'us-east-1'. Remove the default, make it required (or pull from Django settings). infrastructure.py:77-82 — Purpose labels say 'Database (PostgreSQL)' and 'Cache (Redis)'. Change to just 'Database' and 'Cache'.
close_reason: Removed us-east-1 default; Purpose labels now generic

title: ConnectionError shadows Python builtin
description: exceptions.py:22-24 defines ConnectionError(RemoteComposeError) which shadows Python's builtin ConnectionError. Any 'from remote_compose.exceptions import *' or 'except ConnectionError' will catch unexpected types. Fix: rename to RemoteConnectionError.

title: Hardcoded values that kill reusability: IAM roles, ports, CIDRs, public IP, execute command
description:
Multiple files hardcode values that should be configurable:
- ecs_service.py:968 - 'ecsTaskExecutionRole' / 'ecsTaskRole' hardcoded (breaks custom IAM)
- ecs_service.py:774 - assignPublicIp: ENABLED hardcoded (wrong for private subnets)
- ecs_service.py:551 - enableExecuteCommand: True forced on every update (security risk)
- ecs.py:567,575 - Same two hardcoded in model to_aws_create_format()
- security_group_service.py:276-300 - DB port 5432, cache port 6379 hardcoded (only works for Postgres/Redis)
- vpc_service.py:29-32 - Subnet CIDRs hardcoded as 10.0.x.0/24 (breaks with non-10.0.0.0/16 VPC CIDR)
- vpc_service.py:327-328 - Always exactly 2 AZs (no 3-AZ production support)
- ecs.py:57 - aws_region defaults to 'us-east-1' (silent wrong-region deployments)
- infrastructure.py:77-82 - SecurityGroupConfig.Purpose labels hardcoded to 'PostgreSQL'/'Redis'
All should be configurable via get_setting() defaults, model fields, or method parameters.
close_reason: All 9 hardcoded values now configurable

title: S2: Refactor pipeline steps to get services from context instead of inline instantiation
description: After ServiceRegistry exists on PipelineContext, update all execute() methods in deployment_pipeline/steps/ to use context.services.get_ecs_service() etc. instead of ECSService(). Affected: ecs.py:28, ecr.py:37,80, build.py:55-56, infrastructure.py:33,84,142,238,286. Also remove click.echo from ProvisionALBStep (infrastructure.py:188-218) — use pipeline event handler.
close_reason: All pipeline steps refactored to use context.services instead of inline instantiation

title: ecs_service.py (1045 lines) and efs_service.py (1327 lines) need splitting
description: ecs_service.py handles cluster mgmt, task defs, services, tasks, network discovery, IAM roles. Network discovery duplicates VPCService, IAM is its own concern. efs_service.py has file systems, access points, mount targets, security groups (duplicates SecurityGroupService), and ECS volume helpers. Fix: extract IAM to helper, delegate VPC/SG to existing services, split EFS into focused modules.

title: S3: Add schema version check to CLI bootstrap; persist and generate SECRET_KEY per-project
description: cli.py:144 — Instead of running migrate on every invocation, store a schema version in ~/.remote-compose/<project>/schema_version. Only run migrate when version changes or on first run. cli.py:138 — Generate a random SECRET_KEY on first run and persist to ~/.remote-compose/<project>/secret_key. Load from disk on subsequent runs.
close_reason: Schema version check skips migrations when unchanged; SECRET_KEY persisted per-project

title: CLI duplication: cluster lookup 9x, service resolution 4x, exec_cmd
description: Cluster lookup pattern (ECSCluster.objects.get + DoesNotExist + sys.exit) repeated 9 times. Service name resolution (filter + project-prefix fallback) repeated 4 times. exec_cmd (lines 856-964) reimplements 90% of _resolve_ecs_exec_target. Fix: extract _get_cluster(), _resolve_service(), refactor exec_cmd to use existing helpers. File: cli.py

title: S4: Rename test fixtures to generic names; replace inline credential values
description: tests/fixtures/start_simpli_compose.yml → multi_service_compose.yml, start_simpli_service_config.yml → multi_service_config.yml. Replace all 'startsimpli' references with 'myapp'. Replace POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secretpassword, DJANGO_SECRET_KEY: test-secret-key etc. with CHANGE_ME_NOT_A_REAL_SECRET. Update all test imports.
close_reason: Fixtures renamed to multi_service_*, startsimpli→myapp, credentials replaced with CHANGE_ME

title: PipelineContext is a 50+ field god object — split into sub-contexts
description: deployment_pipeline/context.py:27-240 - PipelineContext holds everything from VPC CIDRs to cert ARNs to EFS configs to Django settings. Impossible to know which fields a step reads/writes, creates implicit coupling, will grow unboundedly. Split into sub-contexts: InfrastructureState, ImageState, DeploymentConfig, etc.
close_reason: Context god object decomposed

title: requiresCompatibilities defaults to empty list, fallback to FARGATE never reached
description: ecs.py model field defaults to list (empty []). to_aws_format() checks 'is not None' which is always True for [], so empty list sent to AWS instead of ['FARGATE']. AWS requires at least one. Fix: change default to ['FARGATE'] or fix conditional to truthy check.

title: Generate postgres credentials and create .postgres env file
close_reason: Closed

title: S3: Add database engine abstraction to db backup/restore
description: cli.py:1012-1042, 1162-1218 — Currently hardcoded to pg_dump/pg_restore. Add rc.yml config field 'backup.engine' (default: 'postgresql'). Create abstract BackupEngine class with PostgresBackupEngine implementation. Support future engines (mysql, sqlite) via the abstraction. At minimum, document that only PostgreSQL is currently supported.

title: S2: Refactor ECRService to use AWSClientFactory via constructor injection
description: ecr_service.py:46-94 — Remove _get_ecr_client() and _get_sts_client() methods. Accept AWSClientFactory in __init__. Replace all self._get_ecr_client() calls with self.aws_factory.get_client('ecr', ...). Remove redundant CredentialService instantiation (line 43). Update all callers/tests.

title: Build key generation duplicated in 3 places

title: S1: Replace bare except:pass with logged warnings in cli.py teardown

title: Run rc provision — create VPC, ALB, SGs, secrets, EFS

description: ecs_service.py — 'ecsTaskExecutionRole' appears at lines 968,972,1003,1005,1027,1047,1050. 'ecsTaskRole' at lines 1095,1098,1121,1128,1144. Add get_setting('ECS_TASK_EXECUTION_ROLE', 'ecsTaskExecutionRole') and get_setting('ECS_TASK_ROLE', 'ecsTaskRole'). Apply throughout.

title: API viewsets have zero authentication, authorization, or pagination
description: api/viewsets.py - No viewset defines permission_classes or authentication_classes. Default DRF is AllowAny, meaning SecureCredentialViewSet (encrypted creds), DeploymentViewSet (cancel deployments), and ECSServiceViewSet (scale to zero) are wide open. No pagination_class defined either -- GET /audit-logs/ serializes entire table in one response (DoS vector). Fix: add explicit IsAuthenticated default, add pagination to all list endpoints.
close_reason: All 4 API security fixes applied

title: S2: Make VPC subnet CIDRs derive from VPC CIDR; make AZ count configurable
description: vpc_service.py:29-32 — Subnet CIDRs are class constants (10.0.1.0/24, etc.) that break with non-10.0.0.0/16 VPC CIDR. Compute subnet CIDRs from the VPC CIDR using ipaddress.ip_network.subnets(). vpc_service.py:327-328 — Always takes exactly 2 AZs. Add az_count parameter (default 2, support 3 for production).
close_reason: VPC subnet CIDRs derived from VPC CIDR via ipaddress module; AZ count configurable

2. Have exec_cmd (738-837) call _resolve_ecs_exec_target instead of reimplementing it
3. Remove dead code: unused _step_counter (216-235), dead sc_namespace assignment (512-516), no-op conditional in db_restore (1106), and 5 duplicate imports in _teardown_infrastructure
close_reason: Progress handler factory, exec_cmd uses _resolve_ecs_exec_target, dead code removed. -110 lines

description: vpc_service.py:29-32 hardcodes PUBLIC_SUBNET_1_CIDR='10.0.1.0/24' etc. If different VPC CIDR passed to provision_vpc, subnets may not be within VPC range. Fix: derive subnet CIDRs from vpc_cidr using ipaddress.ip_network.

title: Missing test coverage: ECS models, tracking, infra, mgmt commands, SSH, crypto

Existing tests cover ~30% of codebase. conftest fixtures are clean but unused (mock_ssh_success).

Includes: ico, 26s, vfv, 81v, snq, xjl, v94, 0fs

title: S1: Fix context.errors → context.warnings in finalization.py

title: ecs_deployment_service has two parallel deploy code paths

Fix: deprecate deploy() and route through deploy_with_pipeline(), or remove entirely. File: ecs_deployment_service.py (933 lines)

title: SPRINT 1: Critical Fixes — crashes, data loss, security
description:
Sprint 1 covers all P0 bugs that will crash deployments, leak data, orphan AWS resources, or expose the API unauthenticated. These are targeted surgical fixes — no refactoring, just make things not break.

Includes: ucs (AttributeErrors), cdk (encryption key), egv (teardown orphaning), agi (API security)
Estimated: 4-6 hours of focused work.
close_reason: Sprint 1 complete: all 4 P0 bugs fixed, 266 tests pass

title: Bare except:pass pervasive throughout codebase
description: CLI: 27 bare except Exception blocks, many with pass. Teardown: every operation wrapped in silent exception swallowing. Pipeline: describe_service, deployment record save, EFS model save, event handlers all use except:pass. Polling loops (ecs_service, efs_service) catch Exception and loop forever. Fix: narrow to specific exceptions, log swallowed errors, fail fast on programming bugs.

title: tracking.py 619 lines (3 models) + ecs models 917 lines (5 models) — borderline
description: tracking.py has BuildRecord (247), DeploymentEvent (190), ResourceMetric (182). ecs.py has ECSCluster (152), ECSTaskDefinition (160), ECSService (292), ECRRepository (105), EFSFileSystem (188). Not critical but navigation harder. Consider splitting ECR/EFS into own files.

title: Encryption key auto-generation causes silent data loss
description: cli.py:108-111 - When REMOTE_COMPOSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is not set, a random Fernet key is generated per session. Any encrypted credentials created in one session become permanently unreadable in the next. No warning, no persistence of the generated key. Fix: persist the key to ~/.remote-compose/<project>/encryption.key or refuse to proceed without an explicit key.
close_reason: Fixed: key persistence + warning on auto-generated key

title: Secrets converter generates broken placeholder ARNs
description: compose_converter.py:836 - _convert_secrets generates literal 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:REGION:ACCOUNT:secret:{name}' strings that will cause ECS task launch failures at runtime. No mechanism to replace these placeholders with actual values before registration.
close_reason: Secret ARNs now use cluster.aws_region and account from cluster ARN

title: Fix .django env for ECS Service Connect hostnames
close_reason: Closed

title: No cleanup on partial VPC provisioning failure
description: vpc_service.py:102-241 if provision_vpc fails midway (NAT Gateway creation fails), already-created VPC/subnets/IGW are orphaned. ClientError handler at line 237 does not attempt cleanup. Fix: add try/except calling teardown_vpc on failure, or log which resources were created.

title: cli.py is 1618 lines — split into modules
description: cli.py handles Click group, config, Django bootstrapping, backup engines, ECS exec, teardown, service formatting, and all commands. Split into: cli/main.py, cli/config.py, cli/commands/deploy.py, cli/commands/exec.py, cli/commands/db.py, cli/commands/secrets.py, cli/teardown.py

description: compose_converter.py:843-849 - _convert_command uses str.split() which breaks on quoted arguments. 'bash -c "echo hello world"' becomes ['bash', '-c', '"echo', 'hello', 'world"']. Fix: use shlex.split().

title: Management command duplication: progress handlers, env parsing, context building
description: ecs_provision.py and ecs_deploy_compose.py have near-identical progress_handler closures. deploy.py and ecs_deploy.py duplicate env var parsing (split('=', 1)). Both provision and deploy commands duplicate PipelineContext construction. Fix: extract shared ProgressReporter, env_parser utility, and context factory into base command mixin.

Both delete ALBs, listeners, namespaces, SGs, VPCs, secrets. Fix: extract TeardownService or add teardown methods to existing services (ECSService, VPCService, ALBService), call from both CLI and command.

title: S3: Move EFS security group logic to SecurityGroupService
description: efs_service.py:1018-1128 — get_or_create_efs_security_group(), _get_vpc_cidr(), authorize_security_group_for_efs() should live in SecurityGroupService. Also fix: recursive call with no depth limit on duplicate group (1125-1127, add max retries), and _get_vpc_cidr fallback to 10.0.0.0/8 (line 1146, should raise error not fall back). title: S2: Add service registry/factory to PipelineContext for dependency injection
description: Create a ServiceRegistry class that holds lazily-initialized service instances (ECSService, ECRService, ALBService, etc.). Add it to PipelineContext. Pipeline builder should accept an optional factory or registry. This is the prerequisite for refactoring all pipeline steps.

title: Teardown deletes local DB records even when AWS deletion fails
description: cli.py:1375-1510 and ecs_teardown.py - Both _teardown_infrastructure and the teardown management command use bare 'except Exception: pass' around AWS API calls, then unconditionally delete local DB records. This guarantees orphaned AWS resources (ALBs, security groups, namespaces) that the tool can never clean up again. Fix: only delete local records after confirmed AWS deletion; log warnings for all caught exceptions.
close_reason: Both cli.py and ecs_teardown.py fixed

title: Debug and fix until all health checks pass
close_reason: All health checks passing: redis HEALTHY, postgres HEALTHY, django HEALTHY, nginx HEALTHY. Celery workers show UNKNOWN (expected - no HTTP health endpoint).

title: Pipeline ConfigureInfrastructureEnvStep hardcoded to Django with ALLOWED_HOSTS=*
description: infrastructure.py:395-456 - Step injects Django-specific env vars (ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, etc.) and sets ALLOWED_HOSTS='*' which disables host header validation entirely (enables HTTP Host header attacks). A generic deployment tool should not hardcode framework-specific vars. Fix: make env injection configurable via service config YAML; set ALLOWED_HOSTS to ALB DNS name + custom domain, not wildcard.
close_reason: Env injection configurable, ALLOWED_HOSTS wildcard eliminated

title: API viewset actions leak internal errors and have no pagination
description: 1) Viewset actions return str(e) in 400 responses, leaking AWS errors, ARNs, stack traces. Should log server-side, return sanitized messages, use proper HTTP status codes. 2) No pagination on any endpoint. DeploymentDetailSerializer eagerly serializes all logs inline (N+1). AuditLog, DeploymentEvent, ResourceMetric are unbounded. 3) Scale endpoint has no upper bound validation. Files: api/viewsets.py, api/serializers.py

title: IAM setup step uses direct factory import, not ServiceRegistry
description: infrastructure.py:271-277 SetupIAMRolesStep imports get_aws_client_factory directly instead of going through context.services. Makes step harder to test, inconsistent with other steps. Fix: add iam property to ServiceRegistry or accept factory as parameter.

title: assignPublicIp ENABLED hardcoded for all Fargate tasks
description: ecs_service.py:753 hardcodes assignPublicIp='ENABLED' for every Fargate task including those in private subnets. Exposes containers to internet unnecessarily. Fix: make configurable, default to DISABLED when cluster has private subnets. Model field exists (ecs.py has AssignPublicIp choices) but is not wired through.

title: deploy --services uses comma-separated string instead of Click multiple
description: cli.py:597 uses click.option with manual comma splitting. Click supports multiple=True which is more idiomatic: --services web --services worker. Integrates with completion and help.

description: compose_converter.py convert() at line 131 calls task_definition.save(). convert_preprocessed() and convert_per_service() return unsaved models. Inconsistent side effects. Callers of convert() get unexpected DB write, callers of others can forget to save. Fix: make all three consistent — either always save or never save.

title: AWSClientFactory singleton not safe for multi-tenant Django
description: aws_client_factory.py:288-312 uses module-level singleton. Comment acknowledges thread-safety concern. All threads share factory state — cache clear affects all requests. Fix: consider request-scoped or threading.local() instead of module singleton. Add warning to class docstring.

title: SPRINT 4: Polish — test cleanup, minor quality, factory cleanup

Sprint 4 is cleanup and polish. Rename test fixtures, consolidate tracking models, fix minor code quality issues, clean up the factory pattern.

Includes: boh, 2mo, 5j3, 1ux
Estimated: 4-6 hours. Can happen anytime after Sprint 1.
close_reason: Sprint 4 complete: factory -90 lines, fixtures generic, tracking deduped, context split, 237 tests pass

title: ALB/target group name truncation causes collisions
description: alb_service.py:70-71, 113-114, 260-261 naively truncate names to 32 chars. 'my-very-long-cluster-name-alpha-alb' and 'my-very-long-cluster-name-bravo-alb' both truncate identically. Fix: append short SHA256 hash suffix to preserve uniqueness when truncating.

title: S3: Split PipelineContext into typed sub-contexts
description:
context.py:27-240 — PipelineContext has 50+ fields. Split into:
1. DeploymentConfig (compose_file, project_name, cluster_name, region, domain, etc.)
2. InfrastructureState (vpc_id, subnet_ids, security_group_ids, alb_arn, etc.)
3. ImageState (ecr_repos, built_images, image_tags, etc.)
4. EFSState (efs_id, access_points, mount_targets, etc.)
PipelineContext becomes a thin wrapper holding these 4 sub-contexts. Steps declare which sub-context they need. Requires updating all step execute() methods.
close_reason: Split into DeploymentConfig, InfrastructureState, ImageState, EFSState with backwards-compat properties

title: S1: Add pagination to all list viewsets
description: api/viewsets.py — Add a default pagination class. Either set DEFAULT_PAGINATION_CLASS in DRF config or add pagination_class to each viewset. PageNumberPagination with page_size=50 is a reasonable default. Especially critical for AuditLogViewSet and DeploymentEventViewSet which can have thousands of rows.
close_reason: Added SecuredViewSetMixin (auth+perms), pagination, removed log nesting, fixed error codes

title: S3: Create shared poll_until() utility and migrate all 8 wait methods
description:
Create remote_compose/utils/polling.py with:
  def poll_until(check_fn, timeout, interval=10, timeout_msg='Operation timed out', logger=None):
      start = time.time(); while time.time() - start < timeout: if check_fn(): return True; time.sleep(interval); raise TimeoutError(timeout_msg)

Migrate these 8 methods:
- ecs_service.py:679-732 (wait_for_service_stable)
- efs_service.py:405-441, 868-931, 933-970 (3 wait methods)
- vpc_service.py:333-367, 482-505 (NAT gateway)
- alb_service.py:724-755 (ALB active)
- service_connect_service.py:230-286 (wait_for_operation)
Each becomes a ~5 line wrapper around poll_until(). Cuts ~200 lines total.
close_reason: Shared poll_until() utility created, 8 wait methods migrated. -186 lines net

title: conftest cluster fixture duplicated + test catches overly broad exception
description: 1) cluster fixture defined identically in conftest.py:22 and test_ecs_service.py:32, local shadows shared. 2) test_targets.py:104 uses pytest.raises(Exception) instead of IntegrityError. 3) sample_ssh_key is clearly fake but not documented. title: RecordDeploymentFailureStep defined but never used in any pipeline
description: finalization.py:107-139 defines RecordDeploymentFailureStep, exported in __all__, but not included in any of the four PipelineBuilder definitions. InitializeDeploymentStep.cleanup() handles failure recording instead. Fix: integrate into pipeline failure path or remove.

title: IAM policy failure treated as success — deployment continues without secrets access
description: infrastructure.py:311-315 returns StepResult.ok() when IAM policy update fails. Pipeline continues, creates services with secret references, services crash at startup because execution role can't read secrets. Fix: return StepResult.fail() when secrets configured but IAM policy can't be applied.

title: Deployment model requires context FK but ECS deployments don't use DockerContext
description: deployments.py:29-33 has non-nullable context FK to DockerContext. ECS deployments have no DockerContext, forcing _create_deployment_record to leave deployment unsaved (deployment.id=None). Later steps check .id, skip status updates. Fix: make context nullable or create ECS deployment tracking path.

title: Infinite recursion risk in race condition handlers
description: efs_service.py:1125, security_group_service.py:199, secrets_service.py:135 handle Duplicate errors by recursively calling themselves. If find-existing path consistently fails (permissions, etc), these recurse until stack overflow. Fix: use loop with max-retry count instead of recursion. Files: efs_service.py, security_group_service.py, secrets_service.py

title: HTTPS/SSL support in rc CLI
description: The rc CLI should handle SSL certificates, HTTPS ALB listeners, and auto-configure Django security settings (CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE, ALLOWED_HOSTS) based on the ALB DNS. Users shouldn't need manual env file edits for infrastructure-derived settings. Currently deploying over HTTP with production Django settings causes CSRF cookie failures because secure cookie flags are hardcoded True.
close_reason: HTTPS/SSL support implemented: ALB cert upgrade, auto-injected infra env vars, Django security settings derived from infrastructure state.

title: Inconsistent deployment status: string literals vs enum members
description: initialization.py:78 uses 'failed', multi_service.py:600 uses 'completed' as raw strings. finalization.py:36 uses Deployment.DeploymentStatus.COMPLETED. If enum values change, string literals silently break. Fix: always use enum constants for status assignments.

title: _convert_command uses str.split() instead of shlex.split()
description: compose_converter.py:812-818 splits command strings on whitespace, breaking quoted args. 'sh -c "echo hello"' becomes ['sh', '-c', '"echo', 'hello"']. Docker compose handles this correctly. Fix: use shlex.split(command).

title: S1: Warn user when using auto-generated vs explicit encryption key
description: After implementing key persistence, add a click.echo warning when loading from disk vs env var: 'Using auto-generated encryption key from ~/.remote-compose/...'. Recommend setting REMOTE_COMPOSE_ENCRYPTION_KEY for production.
close_reason: Encryption key now persisted to ~/.remote-compose/{project}/encryption.key with 0600 perms

title: Three runtime AttributeErrors in Deployment model usage
description: 1) ecs_deployment_service.py:525 uses Deployment.Status.IN_PROGRESS which doesn't exist (should be RUNNING). 2) ecs_deployment_service.py:571 assigns to deployment.duration which is a read-only @property (should set completed_at or use _duration). 3) management/commands/ecs_service.py:237 uses log.level but model field is log_level. All three will crash at runtime.

title: ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery on secrets with no double-confirmation
description: cli.py:1576-1579 uses ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True bypassing AWS 30-day recovery window. destroy command has only one generic confirmation. Fix: remove ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery or add separate explicit confirmation about irrecoverable secret deletion.

title: S2: Refactor ECSService to use AWSClientFactory via constructor injection
description: ecs_service.py:51-99 — Remove _get_ecs_client() and _get_ec2_client() methods. Accept AWSClientFactory in __init__. Replace all self._get_ecs_client() calls with self.aws_factory.get_client('ecs', ...). Remove redundant CredentialService instantiation (line 48). Update callers/tests.
close_reason: ECSService now uses AWSClientFactory, ~48 lines removed

title: Pipeline steps have no dependency injection — instantiate services inline
description: Every pipeline step in deployment_pipeline/steps/ creates services with ServiceName() inside execute(). Examples: ecs.py:28, ecr.py:37,80, build.py:55-56, infrastructure.py:33,84,142,238,286. This makes steps impossible to unit test without monkey-patching, defeats the DI pattern used elsewhere, and creates redundant boto3 clients. Steps should accept services via __init__ or through PipelineContext.
close_reason: ServiceRegistry + step refactoring complete

title: Auto-inject infrastructure-derived env vars into secrets
description: rc deploy/provision should auto-generate and push Django env vars derived from infrastructure state: ALLOWED_HOSTS (ALB DNS + service names), CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS (https://ALB-DNS or http:// if no cert), SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE/CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE (True if cert, False if HTTP-only), SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT (True if cert, False otherwise). These should be injected as a separate secrets entry (e.g. rc-infrastructure-env) that gets merged into the task definition environment. Users should not need to manually edit .envs files for settings that depend on ALB/cert/domain config.
close_reason: Added ConfigureInfrastructureEnvStep that auto-injects ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE, SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT based on ALB/cert state. Integrated into converter and multi-service pipeline.

title: _bootstrap_django does 7 things — split into focused functions
description: cli.py:89-171 handles AWS profile setup, Django settings config, secret key generation/persistence, encryption key lookup, django.setup(), schema version checking, and database migration. 7 distinct responsibilities. Fix: break into _set_aws_profile, _get_or_create_secret_key, _configure_django_settings, _migrate_if_needed.

title: ECR/ECS/EFS services bypass AWSClientFactory — duplicate client creation
description: ecr_service.py:46-94, ecs_service.py:51-99, efs_service.py:58-106 - These three services create their own _get_*_client() methods duplicating ~200 lines of credential handling, bypassing AWSClientFactory entirely. Fix: remove _get_*_client() methods, accept AWSClientFactory via constructor injection.
close_reason: All 3 services migrated to factory DI, ~150 lines of duplicate credential handling deleted

title: STS session token not supported in credential handling
description: All credential paths (aws_client_factory.py:158-167, ecs_service.py:62-68, etc) only pass access_key_id and secret_access_key. If stored credential has session_token from STS AssumeRole, it's silently dropped. boto3.client() needs aws_session_token parameter. Fix: pass session_token through all credential paths.

title: _parse_memory unit parsing wrong for bare numbers

The code parameter is optional in base class, all exceptions have code=None. Error code system is unused infrastructure. Fix: assign default codes in each class or remove code ranges from docs.

title: provision_vpc doesn't repopulate subnets when finding existing VPC
description: vpc_service.py:89-100 finds existing VPC by tag but only populates vpc_id and vpc_cidr in defaults. Doesn't discover subnets, gateways, route tables. If DB record deleted but VPC exists in AWS, returned model has empty subnet lists, breaking ALB creation. Fix: discover and populate full infrastructure when finding existing VPC.

title: Runtime AttributeErrors in pipeline finalization and multi_service steps
description:
Three runtime crashes waiting to happen:
1. finalization.py:131 - context.errors does not exist on PipelineContext (no errors attribute)
2. finalization.py:36,127 - Deployment.DeploymentStatus.COMPLETED doesn't exist, model defines Deployment.Status  
3. multi_service.py:250 - ecr_repo.repository_uri should be ecr_repo.aws_repository_uri
These will crash any deployment that reaches finalization or uses shared ECR images.
close_reason: All 3 AttributeError bugs fixed

title: Pipeline __init__.py re-exports everything — slow startup
description: deployment_pipeline/__init__.py imports all step classes and all context classes. Importing PipelineContext triggers loading every step module, which triggers lazy imports of all services. Fix: keep __init__.py minimal (core classes only), let consumers import steps from .steps explicitly.

title: S1: Fix API error status codes — distinguish client vs server errors
description: api/viewsets.py — Multiple viewsets catch 'except Exception as e' and return 400 for everything. ECSServiceViewSet.scale (lines 302-305), ECSClusterViewSet.sync_from_aws (lines 224-227). Catch botocore ClientError separately: map 403→403, 404→404, 5xx→502. Return 500 for unexpected errors, not 400.
close_reason: Added SecuredViewSetMixin (auth+perms), pagination, removed log nesting, fixed error codes

title: _wait_for_alb_active has no failure state detection
description: alb_service.py:454-483 only checks for 'active' state. Does not detect 'failed' or 'provisioning_failed' states. If ALB enters terminal failure, waits full timeout with generic message instead of actual failure reason. Fix: detect failure states and raise with specific error.

title: SPRINT 2: Reusability — stop being a one-project tool
description:
Sprint 2 removes all the project-specific hardcoding that prevents this from being a reusable library. Fixes broken converters, renames shadowed builtins, migrates services to use the client factory, and makes all hardcoded AWS values configurable.

Includes: dh1, cni, bjj, p5j, 7je, n7u, eus
Estimated: 8-12 hours. Depends on Sprint 1 completion.
close_reason: Sprint 2 complete: all P1 bugs and features resolved, 255 tests pass

title: CLI bootstrap runs migrations on every invocation + hardcoded SECRET_KEY
description:
cli.py:144 - call_command('migrate', '--run-syncdb', verbosity=0) runs on every CLI command including read-only ones like 'rc status'. Adds noticeable latency. Should only run on first setup or version mismatch.

cli.py:138 - SECRET_KEY='rc-cli-key' is static for every installation. If the API is ever served from this bootstrap, every installation shares the same signing key. Should be generated and persisted per-project.
close_reason: CLI bootstrap optimized

title: Compose converter: 3 nearly identical convert methods + duplicated volume conversion
description:
compose_converter.py:62-501 - convert(), convert_preprocessed(), and convert_per_service() repeat the same pattern: validate inputs, iterate services, convert, calculate Fargate resources, compute hash, query existing task defs, build ECSTaskDefinition, save. Also:
- _convert_volumes and _convert_volumes_with_efs duplicate most logic (lines 892-1081)
- Duplicate _sanitize_name with different behavior between converter (preserves case, 255 chars) and preprocessor (lowercase, 128 chars) — will cause ECR repo names to not match task def container names
- Duplicate build-key computation in 3 places (build.py:43, multi_service.py:189-192,238, converter:388)
- converter calls task_definition.save() — converter should not have DB side effects (breaks dry-run/testing)
Extract shared helpers, remove DB side effects from converter, consolidate volume conversion.
close_reason: Converter consolidation complete. -75 lines net, 3 methods share core logic

title: S3: Consolidate volume conversion and unify _sanitize_name
description:
compose_converter.py:
1. Merge _convert_volumes (lines 892-1000) and _convert_volumes_with_efs (lines 1001-1081) into one method with optional efs_config parameter. HOST_PATH and BIND handling is identical copy-paste.
2. Unify _sanitize_name: converter version (line 1252, preserves case, 255 chars) vs preprocessor version (line 993, lowercase, 128 chars). Pick one behavior — lowercase + 128 chars is safer for ECR repos. Move to shared utils.
3. Extract build-key computation (f'{context}:{dockerfile}') to BuildInfo method or shared utility.
close_reason: Merged _convert_volumes + _convert_volumes_with_efs into one method; unified _sanitize_name in utils

title: poll_until raises generic TimeoutError instead of custom exception
description: utils/polling.py:31 raises builtin TimeoutError. Rest of codebase uses ECSDeploymentTimeoutError, DeploymentTimeoutError, SSHTimeoutError. Callers must catch both. Fix: accept timeout_exception_class parameter defaulting to TimeoutError.

title: S2: Make infrastructure env injection configurable via service config YAML
description:
infrastructure.py:395-456 ConfigureInfrastructureEnvStep injects Django-specific env vars. Refactor to:
1. Read env overrides from service config YAML (new 'environment_overrides' section)
2. Move Django defaults (ALLOWED_HOSTS, CSRF, etc.) into a 'django' preset that's opt-in
3. Fix ALLOWED_HOSTS='*' → use ALB DNS name + custom_domain from context
4. Default: inject only generic vars (DATABASE_URL, CACHE_URL, etc.)
close_reason: Django vars now opt-in via framework:django in service config; ALLOWED_HOSTS uses actual ALB DNS

title: FARGATE_INCOMPATIBLE_FEATURES dict unused + _resolve_yaml_anchors is no-op
description: 1) compose_preprocessor.py:153-164 defines FARGATE_INCOMPATIBLE_FEATURES but _detect_incompatibilities doesn't use it, uses inline checks instead. 2) _resolve_yaml_anchors (preprocessor.py:375-402) does yaml.safe_load then yaml.dump then caller does yaml.safe_load again — redundant. Fix: use dict in detection or delete it. Return parsed dict directly from _resolve_yaml_anchors.

title: CredentialService instantiated but never used in viewset validate action
description: viewsets.py:109-110 creates CredentialService() but variable 'service' never referenced. AWS validation path uses get_aws_client_factory() directly. Fix: remove unused import and instantiation.

title: EFS service mixes concerns — manages security groups internally instead of using SecurityGroupService
description: efs_service.py:1018-1128 - get_or_create_efs_security_group(), _get_vpc_cidr(), authorize_security_group_for_efs() are EC2 security group operations embedded in an EFS service. SecurityGroupService already exists for this. Also: recursive call with no depth limit on duplicate group (line 1125-1127) and _get_vpc_cidr falls back to 10.0.0.0/8 which opens NFS to entire class A range (line 1146). Additionally _find_file_system_by_name makes N+1 describe_tags calls when tags are already in describe_file_systems response.
close_reason: EFS service concerns separated

title: _sync_alb_to_db and teardown_vpc use factory without region/credential
description: alb_service.py:426 _sync_alb_to_db creates client without region/credential context. vpc_service.py:365 teardown_vpc same issue. If resources in non-default region, teardown/sync will fail silently. Fix: accept and pass region/credential parameters.

title: API has no authentication or authorization on any endpoint
description: No viewset defines permission_classes or authentication_classes. SecureCredentialViewSet allows full CRUD on encrypted credentials with zero auth. ECSServiceViewSet.scale allows unauthenticated scaling. Fix: set REST_FRAMEWORK defaults or add IsAuthenticated to every viewset. Files: api/viewsets.py

title: S4: Clean up AWSClientFactory: remove 12 convenience methods, document singleton limitation
description: aws_client_factory.py:188-274 — Remove get_ecs_client(), get_ecr_client(), etc. (12 single-line wrappers). Update callers to use factory.get_client('ecs', ...). Add docstring to get_client() listing supported service names. aws_client_factory.py:377-401 — Add docstring warning about multi-tenant Django limitation of the singleton pattern. ecr_service.py:590-615 — Remove get_account_id() and use factory's validate_credentials() instead.
close_reason: Removed 11 convenience methods (~90 lines), updated all callers to get_client(), added singleton warning

title: DockerContext.save() race condition + ECSService.clean() never called
description: 1) contexts.py:57-61 save() clears other defaults then saves, not atomic. Two concurrent saves with is_default=True can both succeed. Fix: use select_for_update or transaction.atomic. 2) ecs.py:496-505 clean() validates min/max/desired counts but never called by save() or objects.create(). Fix: override save() to call full_clean() or add DB constraint.

title: ImageBuildService exceptions defined in service file, not exceptions.py
description: ImageBuildError and ImagePushError defined in image_build_service.py:59-73, breaking pattern of all exceptions in exceptions.py. Harder to discover and import from consistent location. Fix: move to exceptions.py alongside other Docker error subclasses.

title: S3: Remove DB side effects from compose converter
description: compose_converter.py:306,489 — convert_preprocessed() and convert_per_service() call task_definition.save(). A converter should transform data, not persist it. Move .save() calls to the pipeline step or service layer that calls the converter. This enables dry-run mode and makes the converter testable without a database.
close_reason: Removed .save() from converter; pipeline steps now save explicitly

title: S1: Remove eager log nesting from DeploymentDetailSerializer
description: api/serializers.py:580 — DeploymentDetailSerializer has 'logs = DeploymentLogSerializer(many=True)' which eagerly serializes ALL log entries inline. Deployment logs are already available via /deployments/{id}/logs/ action endpoint. Remove the nested serializer or limit to last 50 entries with source='logs.all[:50]'.
close_reason: Added SecuredViewSetMixin (auth+perms), pagination, removed log nesting, fixed error codes
